rootCause: The .NET Framework redirected stdin writer emitted EF BB BF under a UTF-8 console before the explicit JSON-RPC writer. The synthetic Node server correctly rejected the non-JSON prefix.
fix: Use owned byte pipes, inherit only the three stdio handles and attach the suspended child to its lifetime job before resuming. Preserve the caller console encoding.
localRegression: 404 native checks passed including the UTF-8 console case; cloud revalidation required.
